newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Usiminas still a neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Usiminas still a neutral.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it was maintaining its neutral rating on Brazilian private steelmaker Usina Siderurgica do Minas Gerais SA.
-- It said average price in the first quarter was 463.84 reais per tonne thanks to a better product mix and continuing recovery of the domestic market.
-- But it noted that, although the signs of a domestic recovery are encouraging, "we are concerned that credit tightening may dampen demand in the short-term."
-- Merrill Lynch also said Usiminas' 77.9 million real net profit in the third quarter was only slightly below its forecast of 83.5 million reais and "was therefore in line with our expectations."
